headline: HOW CARNIVOROUS PLANTS DIGEST LIVE PREY
timely_reason: High sustained Wikipedia pageviews on Dionaea muscipula and surging Reddit interest in nutrient-poor bog adaptations.
facts: Trigger hairs require two mechanical stimulations within 20 seconds to fire calcium ion action potentials.
Acid glands flood the sealed trap chamber with hydrochloric enzymes at a pH of 1.5–2.0.
Digestion extracts essential nitrogen and phosphorus, allowing survival in sterile, acidic peat bogs.
